Message.En:
By throwing a rope at the intended enemy, you
can capture them and quickly
approach your target.
<KC WEAPON_SUB>[Rope Stance] [<KC WEAPON_SUB>] + [<KC THROW_ROPE>] Throw Rope
Additionally, you can also launch your
allies high into the sky.
<KC CATAPULT>[Linking Throw]
Message.Jp:
狙った敵にロープを投げて捉えることで
対象に急接近することができます
　【<KC WEAPON_SUB>】ロープ構え
　【<KC WEAPON_SUB>】＋【<KC THROW_ROPE>】ロープ投げ
また、味方を空中高く打ち上げることもできます
　【<KC CATAPULT>】連係投げ
